_comment: Cloudflare Zone-Level Settings — Apply via Cloudflare API or Terraform cloudflare_zone_settings_override resource.
_instructions: 1. Import zone ID from Cloudflare dashboard. 2. Apply with: curl -X PATCH 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/{ZONE_ID}/settings' -H 'Authorization: Bearer {TOKEN}' -d @cloudflare-settings.json

ssl._note: Full (Strict) — origin must present a valid CA-signed certificate. Never use 'flexible' (sends plaintext to origin).

always_use_https._note: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS at the edge.

security_level._note: Challenge visitors with suspicious reputation scores. Tune to 'high' if DDoS is detected.

bot_management._note: Enable Super Bot Fight Mode. This requires a Cloudflare Pro plan or higher. Googlebot bypass is configured in cloudflare-waf-rules.json.

ddos_protection._note: Cloudflare will alert and challenge at lower thresholds. Configure Cloudflare Notifications > DDoS Attack Alert to page on-call SRE team.

http3._note: Enable QUIC / HTTP3 for improved mobile network performance.

early_hints._note: Send 103 Early Hints for faster resource preloading.

browser_cache_ttl._note: 4-hour browser cache for non-versioned responses. Versioned assets override this via Cache-Control immutable header.

origin_shield._note: Enable Argo Tiered Caching / Origin Shield. Choose region closest to your origin server. Cache misses proxy to this PoP before hitting origin.
